text:
toni: heads up — reproducible issue in sampleapp: function_call + JSON mode yields occasional top-level arrays instead of object, breaking our schema validator. Seen by a few customers.

vik: any raw example?

toni: logged raw: `["create_org", {"name":"acme"}]` vs expected `{"action":"create_org","params":{...}}`

frank: is this definitely model output or SDK post-processing?

toni: correlates with auth refresh/retry bump we released. When retry happens during streaming the assembler can rewrap tokens and produce array-wrapped payloads.

lina: quick mitigation: in sampleapp validator add a lenient coercion path: detect [str,obj] -> {action: str, params: obj} and emit telemetry `sdk.fncall.coerce.v1`. Feature-flag it.

vik: parity note: JS SDK already had this lenient fallback; Python and Go are strict. We should standardize behavior and document migration.

eng-tools-bot: created issue #2510 (devex/sdk): "stream+retry: array-wrapped fn_call outputs; add assembler reset and optional coercion" assigned to @frank. Labels: [bug, sdk, onboarding].

frank: plan — sampleapp hotfix today with coercion flag; SDK patch next week to reset assembler state on retry + add unit tests; then a follow-up to add opt-in lenient helper across SDKs.

toni: also pinging @eng-ml to confirm no prompt change. leaving notes for support to enable coercion flag for affected customers. :thumbsup:
